I usually + adv/prep: › [ I usually + adv/prep ] informal to walk somewhere quickly and confidently, often in a way that annoys other people
（常指以令人厭煩的方式）神態自若地走，大搖大擺地走

example: You can't just waltz into my bedroom without knocking - it's private!
你不能連門也不敲就大搖大擺地進我的臥室——這是私人空間！
My idiot husband has gone and waltzed off with my car keys and left me without any way to get to work!
我那白癡丈夫帶著我的車鑰匙悠然離去，害得我沒辦法去上班！
